## Clean Architecture

All code follows Clean Architecture — dependencies point inward. Layers: Entities → Use Cases → Interface Adapters → Frameworks & Drivers. Cross-boundary data uses DTOs, not entities.

## Security by Design

Security is a first-class constraint: (1) Validate all inputs at system boundaries — reject early, reject explicitly. (2) Principle of least privilege — grant minimal access for each operation. (3) Fail securely — default-denied access, explicit allow-lists. (4) Defense in depth — multiple independent checks, not a single gate. (5) No secrets in code — use env vars or config, never literals. (6) Immutable domain entities where possible.

## Project Conventions

- Java 21 LTS / Spring Boot 3.4.4 — Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`), no global Maven required
- Entrypoint: `org.maglez.Main` — `@SpringBootApplication` with `GET /health`
- Test framework: JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Test
- Domain under `org.maglez.eop.*` — STRIDE categories, threat cards, privilege escalation
- All commit messages MUST start with `[THREAT-NNN]` (Jira prefix)
- Agents defined in `.opencode/agents/` — multi-agent team with subagent mode
